# Place Name

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:PlaceName`](gmeow-PlaceName.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/PlaceName>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/names`](../../slices/names.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

An appellation (toponym) borne by a geographic place via [`gmeow:hasPlaceName`](../properties/gmeow-hasPlaceName.md) — possibly endonym/exonym ([`gmeow:namePurpose`](../properties/gmeow-namePurpose.md)), multilingual, or historical (held over a period via a [`gmeow:NameUsage`](gmeow-NameUsage.md) / inferred [`gmeow:PlaceNaming`](gmeow-PlaceNaming.md)). The structured, first-class replacement for the retired flat gmeow:alternateName literal, used for gazetteer matching and co-equal multilingual/historical naming.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Appellation`](gmeow-Appellation.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:PlaceName`](gmeow-PlaceName.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Appellation`](gmeow-Appellation.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for a structured toponym borne by a geographic place — an endonym, exonym, multilingual, or historical name — when gazetteer matching or co-equal place naming is needed.

### Avoid when

- Avoid the retired flat gmeow:alternateName literal and avoid ranking endonym above exonym — competing and historical place names are co-equal PlaceNamings; superseded ones set [`gmeow:displayable`](../properties/gmeow-displayable.md) false, never deletion.

### How to use

- Mint one [`PlaceName`](gmeow-PlaceName.md) per co-equal toponym, set [`gmeow:fullName`](../properties/gmeow-fullName.md) and [`gmeow:nameLanguage`](../properties/gmeow-nameLanguage.md), tag endonym/exonym with [`gmeow:namePurpose`](../properties/gmeow-namePurpose.md), and bear it with [`gmeow:hasPlaceName`](../properties/gmeow-hasPlaceName.md); carry the toponymic authority and period by promoting to a [`gmeow:PlaceNaming`](gmeow-PlaceNaming.md) with [`gmeow:usageAuthority`](../properties/gmeow-usageAuthority.md) and [`gmeow:usageInterval`](../properties/gmeow-usageInterval.md).

### Examples

- ex:istanbulName a [`gmeow:PlaceName`](gmeow-PlaceName.md); [`gmeow:fullName`](../properties/gmeow-fullName.md) "İstanbul"@tr; [`gmeow:namePurpose`](../properties/gmeow-namePurpose.md) [`gmeow:namePurposeEndonym`](../individuals/gmeow-namePurposeEndonym.md).
